Spice from the DUNE series of novels and movies is arguably the most famous substance in Science Fiction allowing humans to extend their lifespan, Enhances awareness and cognition and Allows Guild Navigators to fold space. But how does it work and was the whole thing literally based off of Frank Herbert’s magic mushroom trips?

Noted Kyle-satz Hill-derach Dr. Kyle Hill explains the real-world science behind DUNE'sSpice, including its connection to said psychedelic mushrooms, what melange could do to the human body in the real world and how reversing the biological hallmarks of aging might allow humans to live for centuries.
